_comment: RTL sim tests that warrant a RELEASE Jira ticket when they fail. Each failed test reported by the 'RTL Sim CI test' check is matched by (config, group, filter, runner); a field omitted in an entry is a wildcard, and `filter` is compared literally (the '*' characters are part of the gtest filter string, not matcher wildcards). Entries are tried in order, so keep specific entries above wildcard ones. Optional per-entry fields: requirement (AIIPSW ticket key, added as a label), team, assignee (Jira accountId), assignee_name (human label, ignored by code). Fields prefixed with '_' are documentation only. Tests not listed here are ignored (no ticket).
_coverage: Generated inventory of every Quasar test, where it runs, and which of these entries watches it: tests/scripts/quasar/QUASAR_TEST_COVERAGE.md (regenerate with tests/scripts/quasar/gen_test_coverage_doc.py).
_reaches_jira_today: Verified 2026-08-12 against GitLab tensix/tt-umd-simulators main. Only ONE job feeds this matcher: metal_unit_test_vcs_qsr, which runs the config-1x3 rows of tests/scripts/quasar/quasar_sim_regresion_tests.yaml and labels every manifest row '1x3'. So the only tuples that can arrive today are unit_tests_legacy/*DmLoopback*, unit_tests_legacy/*QuasarComputeKernelMultipleThread*, unit_tests_legacy/*Bmm and unit_tests_api/*TensixSingleCoreDirectDramReaderDatacopyWriter. Since tt-umd-simulators!125 (merged 2026-08-12) that job records passes as well as failures in test_results.tsv and ships the full result set to the check as rtl-sim-results/v1 JSON, so release_test_report.py reports evidence rather than inferring it. Everything else below is staged: it matches a row in quasar_regression_tests.yaml or quasar_local_tests.yaml, which today run in the emulator job (metal_unit_test_emu_quasar) that reports to Slack #tt-qsr-emu-ci and does not write that manifest. Those entries activate with no change here once that job feeds it.
_requirements_comment: The AIIPSW requirements the release report accounts for, so it can state which features have test evidence and which do not. Read from Jira on 2026-08-12 (epics AIIPSW-1 Jul-15, AIIPSW-5 Aug-15, AIIPSW-10 Sept-15); the epics gain children over time, so refresh this list when the milestone set changes. A requirement with no entry in relevant_tests below has no automated Quasar evidence.
